nodes.name: ▶️ Execute Sub-workflow Trigger
nodes.notes:
Expected input: MULTIPLE n8n items (one per image to render), each shaped:
{
  "index": 1,
  "layout": "single | story | carousel-opening | carousel-middle | carousel-closing",
  "headline": "...",
  "body": "...",
  "badge": "...",
  "cta": "...",
  "background_prompt": "... | null",
  "width": 1080,
  "height": 1080
}
Output (per item, original index order): { "index": 1, "imageUrl": "https://..." }.
Caller (Plan 16-06) must invoke Execute Workflow with one n8n item per image — this sub-workflow does NOT fan out a single wrapper object itself (unlike 🔁 Re-host Images, which explodes an image_urls array — here the caller already provides one item per image so the poll loop can process strictly one render at a time).

nodes.name: 🔁 Loop Over Items
nodes.notes: Processes one item (one image render) at a time — the Creatomate poll loop cannot safely have multiple renders in flight. Output 0 (done) fires once all items are processed, accumulating every looped-back { index, imageUrl } result. Output 1 (loop) emits the current single item into the render chain; the chain MUST loop back to this node's input after each item completes (via ✅ Return) to advance to the next batch.

// Proven regex from scripts/eval-design-engines.js substitutePlaceholders()
// (Plan 15-04, live-verified against real Ideogram/Creatomate/Gamma/FAL
// renders). null/undefined values become an empty string; double quotes
// inside substituted text are escaped so the surrounding JSON stays valid.
function substitutePlaceholders(obj, values) {
  const json = JSON.stringify(obj);
  const replaced = json.replace(/\{\{\s*([A-Z_]+)\s*\}\}/g, (m, key) => {
    const v = values[key];
    return v == null ? "" : String(v).replace(/"/g, '\\"');
  });
  return JSON.parse(replaced);
}

const item = $json;
const layout = item.layout;
const templateElementsForLayout = TEMPLATES[layout];
if (!templateElementsForLayout) {
  throw new Error('🧩 Prep Render: unknown layout "' + layout + '" — expected one of single, story, carousel-opening, carousel-middle, carousel-closing');
}

const needsFlux = Boolean(item.background_prompt);

// Substitute HEADLINE/BODY/BADGE/CTA now. Deliberately KEEP {{BACKGROUND_URL}}
// unresolved at this stage (pass its own placeholder text back as the
// substitution value) — the Flux stage (or the skip path) fills it in
// later. carousel-closing has no BACKGROUND_URL token at all, which is
// exactly the intended Flux-skip + Creatomate-only closing-slide behavior.
// This does NOT early-return a "no image" marker like the eval harness did —
// that shortcut is intentionally NOT ported here (Research Finding 6 / plan
// 16-02 truth #2).
const substituted = substitutePlaceholders(
  { elements: templateElementsForLayout },
  {
    HEADLINE: item.headline,
    BODY: item.body,
    BADGE: item.badge,
    CTA: item.cta,
    BACKGROUND_URL: "{{BACKGROUND_URL}}",
  }
);

const dims = DIMENSIONS[layout];

return {
  json: {
    index: item.index,
    layout,
    width: item.width || dims.width,
    height: item.height || dims.height,
    background_prompt: item.background_prompt || null,
    needs_flux: needsFlux,
    render_elements: substituted.elements,
  },
};

nodes.name: 🧩 Prep Render
nodes.notes: Picks the brand template by layout, substitutes HEADLINE/BODY/BADGE/CTA (embedded verbatim from creatomate/templates/*.json — regenerate this node if those files change), and sets needs_flux = Boolean(background_prompt). Null background_prompt means Flux-skip + Creatomate-only render — it still renders a real image, never an early no-image marker.

nodes.notes: TRUE (needs_flux) → ⚡ Flux Background. FALSE (null/absent background_prompt, e.g. carousel-closing) → skip Flux entirely, go straight to the Creatomate-only insert-background step.

"square_hd" : { width: $json.width, height: $json.height }, num_inference_steps: 28, guidance_scale: 3.5, num_images: 1, enable_safety_checker: true }) }}

nodes.name: ⚡ Flux Background
nodes.notes: FAL Flux 2 Pro synchronous endpoint — params byte-identical to production's flux-generate node / the proven scripts/eval-design-engines.js callFalFluxBackground(): num_inference_steps 28, guidance_scale 3.5, num_images 1, enable_safety_checker true, image_size square_hd when width===height else {width,height} (story 1080x1920). Prompt suffix uses the CANONICAL palette #070A18/#8000A8-#BA00E0 (Research Pitfall 4 — NOT the pre-Phase-15 dark-navy palette).

nodes.name: 🧩 Insertar Fondo (Flux)
nodes.notes: Substitutes the Flux-generated background URL into the {{BACKGROUND_URL}} token left unresolved by 🧩 Prep Render.

nodes.name: 🧩 Insertar Fondo (Skip)
nodes.notes: Flux-skip path (null/absent background_prompt — e.g. carousel-closing). Substitutes {{BACKGROUND_URL}} with an empty string; harmless since templates using this path never reference it. Still renders via Creatomate — this is the closing-slide behavior, not a skip of the whole item.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ output_format: "png", width: $json.width, height: $json.height, source: { elements: $json.elements } }) }}

nodes.name: 🖌️ Creatomate Create
nodes.notes: POST /v1/renders (NOT /v2 — 404s on this account, confirmed live during Plan 15-01). Body: { output_format: png, width, height, source: { elements } }. Response is 202 Accepted with { id, status } — neverError:true configured so 2xx (incl. 202) is always treated as success.

nodes.name: ⏱️ Check Status
nodes.notes: Tracks poll_count, throws loud on status===failed or poll_count>40 (~120s budget at 3s waits). Entered both right after 🖌️ Creatomate Create and after every 🔧 Fusionar Resultado Poll loop-back.

nodes.name: ✅ ¿Render Completo?
nodes.notes: TRUE (succeeded) → ✅ Return. FALSE (queued/rendering/etc.) → wait 3s and poll again.

nodes.name: ✅ Return
nodes.notes: Emits { index, imageUrl } and loops back to 🔁 Loop Over Items to advance to the next batch.

nodes.name: ⏳ Espera 3s
nodes.notes: 3s poll interval, matching the proven eval harness's Creatomate poll cadence.

nodes.name: 🔎 Poll GET Creatomate
nodes.notes: GET /v1/renders/{id} — returns current { id, status, url } for the in-progress render.

nodes.name: 🔧 Fusionar Resultado Poll
nodes.notes: Recovers poll_count (dropped by the HTTP GET node) from ⏱️ Check Status's most recent output before looping back to it.

nodes.name: 🗂️ Collect Results
nodes.notes: Final aggregation off 🔁 Loop Over Items' done output — re-sorts the accumulated { index, imageUrl } items by index before returning to the caller (Plan 16-06's parent workflow).
